newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat to easier in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat to easier in slow trade.

text.p: NWE oil products were flat to lower on Monday in a typically slow start to the week.
Gas oil eased in line with futures. Heating oil barges traded at $1.0 and $1.25 fob Rotterdam for first half delivery.
Fuel oil markets were slightly softer with no trade seen on high sulphur barges by midday in Europe and offer levels down $1. Low sulphur swaps were soft with buying interest for physical poor.
Gasoline was flat. Eurograde storage barges were done at $204.50 a tonne fob ARA, and refinery Eurograde material at $207.00.
